title: Range for visualization - From value jumps to another value
body:
Version 3.2.0-beta1

Unit: mg/dl

It doesn't work at all via the setup assistant. 
If you enter 70 via the assistant, 126 will be saved
he probably always assumes mmol/l, 70 is too much for him and that's why he assumes that 7 mmol is meant and converts that into 126 mg/dl

If I then go in normally via Settings, it says 7.0 inside, wear 75, fits, is saved.
Apparently the assistant always starts with mmol/l values!?

mmol/l x 18,0182 = mg/dl, 7 mmol/l = 126,1274 mg/dl

Chris
